evals.prompt: Add push notifications to this generated mobile app. Signed-out devices should receive allUsers broadcasts, signed-in devices should use the Entra OID as the FCM topic, and tapping a notification should open the work item detail route.
evals.expected_output: The skill verifies runtime packages and host OID support, configures permission UX, topic lifecycle, and validated Expo Router deep links, or blocks precisely on a missing prerequisite.

evals.prompt: The user denied notifications during onboarding. Add a settings option that lets them enable notifications later without breaking sign-in.
evals.expected_output: The skill preserves sign-in, models denied permission, adds an Open Settings recovery path, and does not repeatedly show the OS prompt.

evals.prompt: Set up FCM topics in an older app whose package.json has expo-notifications but whose Power Apps Developer runtime does not include React Native Firebase Messaging.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops with a native-runtime blocker and does not install packages or create a fake wrapper.
